repo.windows.py:
"""Windows over the samples feed."""
import itertools


def summarize_window(feed, size):
    """Read the next `size` samples from the feed and return (peak dose, list of dose).

    The feed may be endless. Exactly `size` items are read from it.
    """
    window = itertools.islice(feed, size)
    peak = max(x.dose for x in window)
    values = [x.dose for x in window]
    return peak, values


def describe_sample(sample):
    """Return a one-line description of a sample."""
    return "%s: %s" % (sample.batch, sample.dose)

from samples import feed_samples, ROWS
from windows import summarize_window


def test_values():
    peak, values = summarize_window(feed_samples(), 3)
    assert values == [v for _, v in ROWS[:3]]


def test_reads_only_the_window():
    feed = feed_samples()
    summarize_window(feed, 2)
    assert next(feed).dose == ROWS[2][1]
